records.subject: Template-free two-step electrodeposition in ionic liquids
records.quote: Te-Bi core-shell nanowires were synthesized by electrochemical deposition in ionic liquids without using a template.
context_quotes: The nanowires were synthesized in two steps: self-standing single crystal Te nanowires with a diameter of 76.2 +/- 28.4 nm and a length of a few microns were electrodeposited first, taking advantage of the templating properties of the mixture of ionic liquids EOPipTFSI:EOPipBr 95:5 mole%.
The Bi shell was then deposited on the Te core in EOPipTFSI.
